Welcome to Ramberg!

The space
Welcome to Ramberg – your perfect base for exploring Lofoten!

Come and experience the beauty of Lofoten from the heart of Ramberg, a charming coastal village surrounded by dramatic mountains, turquoise waters and some of the region’s most beautiful beaches. Our comfortable and centrally located home is the perfect choice for families, friends and groups looking for a relaxing stay with easy access to the many highlights of western Lofoten.

The house features four bedrooms, each with a double bed, and can comfortably accommodate up to eight guests. With its spacious layout and central location, it is an excellent base for enjoying everything the area has to offer. And if you are travelling with your four-legged friend, you are welcome to bring your dog along – your furry family member can enjoy the Lofoten adventure too!

One of the biggest attractions nearby is the famous Ramberg Beach, just a short distance from the house. With its soft white sand, crystal-clear turquoise water and spectacular mountain backdrop, it is one of Lofoten’s most iconic beaches. Take a morning walk along the shore, enjoy a picnic, go for a refreshing dip or simply sit back and take in the scenery. Even on a cloudy day, the landscape is breathtaking.

Ramberg itself offers a convenient selection of local services, including shops, cafés and other amenities, making it easy to have a comfortable stay without needing to travel far. The village is also perfectly positioned along the scenic E10, making it an excellent starting point for exploring the surrounding areas.

From Ramberg, you can easily discover many of the highlights of Flakstad and Moskenes. Drive west and explore beautiful coastal villages, dramatic mountain landscapes and secluded beaches. Flakstad Beach and the historic Flakstad Church are close by, while Nusfjord, one of Lofoten’s best-preserved traditional fishing villages, is a wonderful place to visit for a taste of the area's history and culture.

Continue further west and you will reach some of Lofoten’s most famous destinations, including Reine, Hamnøy and Sakrisøy, known for their traditional red fishing cabins and spectacular mountain scenery. The picturesque village of Reine is also the starting point for the popular Reinebringen hike, offering one of the most impressive panoramic views in Lofoten.

For those who enjoy outdoor activities, the area around Ramberg is a fantastic playground. There are opportunities for hiking, surfing, kayaking, fishing, cycling, photography and beach walks, while the surrounding mountains provide endless possibilities for exploring the great outdoors. During summer, the midnight sun creates long, golden evenings, while autumn and winter offer the chance to experience the magical Northern Lights.

Whether you are looking for an active holiday filled with hikes and adventures, a relaxing beach getaway, or simply want to explore the spectacular scenery of Lofoten, Ramberg is an ideal place to stay.
